title: Data Analyst
description:
Role: Data Analyst

Location: Carmarthen

Salary: £42,068


We are proud to be partnered with a well-established public sector organisation who is looking to add a Data Analyst to the team to work through some exciting projects.


This is an exciting opportunity to apply your expertise to projects that drive meaningful social and environmental impact!


Key Responsibilities

  • Produce clear, accurate reporting and insights using internal and external data sources.
  • Develop, maintain, and promote Power BI dashboards to support data-driven decision-making across the organisation.
  • Manage and maintain core performance measures, ensuring KPIs are accurate, timely, and published in line with internal deadlines.
  • Champion data quality, integrity, and validation standards across all reporting.
  • Work collaboratively with teams to understand business needs and deliver effective analysis and business intelligence.
  • Own the end-to-end data process, including collection, cleansing, validation, analysis, and presentation of data for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Complete required statutory and regulatory data returns.
  • Support Subject Access Requests by gathering relevant data and producing compliant documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to automate reporting and improve efficiency.


Think this one's for you?

If you think this Data Analyst role is for you then apply online.
